newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM Intl shares up on rosy sector outlook.
newsitem.headline: ASM Intl shares up on rosy sector outlook.

text.p: Shares in Dutch semiconductor equipment maker ASM International were up 10 percent to 31.00 guilders on Monday on increasingly upbeat sector prospects.
Analysts said U.S. investors in particular were chasing issues in the semiconductor industry and this had pushed the Dutch stock higher in the past few trading sessions.
Dutch broker Wesselius issued a buy recomendation on ASM International late last week, saying the company had the capability to finance its own growth over the next two years.
